description: This file defines TypeScript types, functions, and constants for managing and querying JSON schema configurations, including schema merging, hint collection, and schema lookup functionalities within a configuration system.

methods.name: collectExtensionHintKeys
methods.description: Collects all hint keys from plugins and channels, including nested schema keys, for extension purposes.

methods.name: applyPluginHints
methods.description: Applies plugin UI hints to the existing hints, adding labels and help texts based on plugin metadata.

methods.name: applyChannelHints
methods.description: Applies channel UI hints to the existing hints, updating labels and help texts.

methods.name: listHeartbeatTargetChannels
methods.description: Generates an ordered list of channel IDs for heartbeat delivery, including defaults and user-defined channels.

methods.name: applyHeartbeatTargetHints
methods.description: Adds help and placeholder hints for heartbeat target configuration paths.

methods.name: applyPluginSchemas
methods.description: Merges plugin-specific schemas into the main configuration schema under plugin entries.

methods.name: applyChannelSchemas
methods.description: Merges channel-specific schemas into the main configuration schema under channel entries.

methods.name: buildMergedSchemaCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string based on plugin and channel metadata for schema caching.

methods.name: setMergedSchemaCache
methods.description: Stores a schema response in the cache with a specific key, managing cache size.

methods.name: getBundledChannelSchemaMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves bundled channel metadata entries from generated constants.

methods.name: buildBaseConfigSchema
methods.description: Constructs the base configuration schema response, applying hints and caching.

methods.name: buildConfigSchema
methods.description: Builds the complete configuration schema response, optionally caching and merging plugin/channel schemas.

methods.name: normalizeLookupPath
methods.description: Normalizes a schema lookup path string, converting array indices and removing extraneous dots.

methods.name: splitLookupPath
methods.description: Splits a normalized lookup path into its segments.

methods.name: resolveUiHintMatch
methods.description: Resolves UI hints for a given schema path, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: resolveItemsSchema
methods.description: Resolves the schema for array items, supporting both array and single object schemas.

methods.name: resolveLookupChildSchema
methods.description: Resolves a child schema for a given path segment, considering properties, array indices, and additional properties.

methods.name: stripSchemaForLookup
methods.description: Strips a JSON schema down to essential keys for lookup purposes.

methods.name: buildLookupChildren
methods.description: Builds child schema entries for a given schema node, including hints and required status.

methods.name: lookupConfigSchema
methods.description: Performs a schema lookup for a specific path within a configuration schema response, returning schema details and hints.
